about.hero_quote: "SOURCE was born out of a recognition that 's scientific potential — vast, distributed, and underserved by legacy systems — needed a platform equal to its ambition."
about.hero_desc: Established under the mandate of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, SOURCE — the System for Organizational University, Research & Classification Excellence — national infrastructure for managing, classifying, and elevating academic research output.
about.mission_title: To unify, elevate, and make visible 's scientific research output.
about.mission_desc: SOURCE exists to give every researcher, institution, and journal in  the infrastructure they need to produce, manage, and share scholarly work at the highest international standards. We are the connective tissue between 's universities and the global scientific community.
about.vision_title: as a recognized contributor to global scientific knowledge.
about.vision_desc: We envision an  where academic research is systematically captured, properly classified, and internationally discoverable — where the work of  scholars is visible on the world stage and where the quality of institutional output is measurable, comparable, and continuously improving.
about.story_desc: Before SOURCE, 's universities managed research outputs through disconnected, institution-specific systems — creating duplication, gaps in the national record, and an inability to measure or benchmark academic performance at the ministerial level.
about.milestone1_desc: The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research formally establishes the need for a unified national research management system across all  universities.
about.milestone2_desc: A cross-institutional working group comprising university representatives, ministry officials, and technical experts begins the architecture and requirements phase.
about.milestone3_desc: SOURCE enters a controlled pilot phase founding universities across Baghdad — validating the classification framework and submission workflows.
about.milestone4_desc: The platform is extended to all public universities in , with training programmes and dedicated institutional support teams deployed nationwide.
about.values_desc: The principles that guide how we build, operate, and evolve the SOURCE platform — for the long-term benefit of  higher education.
about.value1_desc: Every process within SOURCE is designed to uphold the highest standards of scholarly work — from submission to peer review to publication.
about.value2_desc: Full audit trails, open decision logs, and ministerial oversight at every level ensure that the platform operates with complete institutional accountability.
about.value3_desc: SOURCE is built by and for  institutions — reflecting the realities, languages, and administrative structures of 's higher education landscape.
about.value4_desc: The platform evolves in response to user feedback, international best practices, and the changing needs of 's growing research ecosystem.
about.value5_desc: Connecting researchers, institutions, journals, and the ministry into one unified network — removing silos and enabling the cross-institutional collaboration that advances science.
about.value6_desc: All classification and indexing processes follow international academic standards

home.hero_kicker: The National Research Excellence Management System
home.hero_desc: One system bringing the Ministry, universities and researchers together: it starts from the decision-maker's needs, equips universities to manage quality, accreditation and rankings, and accompanies every researcher step by step — from the first idea to beyond publication.
home.stage_undergrad_desc: Research readiness and early screening: a first assessment of topic, methodology, references and language — preventive, educational services, never final academic verdicts.
home.stage_grad_desc: Research development and publication support: expert review, research gap analysis, journal matching, compliance checks and responses to reviewers.
home.stage_faculty_desc: Advanced research and publication management: full evaluation, expert peer review, publication strategy and journal portfolio, and an end-to-end pipeline from draft to post-publication.
home.fact1_label: sequential components, in order of need
home.fact3_label: research services that scale with the researcher's level
home.fact4_label: National Strategy for Higher Education & Scientific Research
home.components_title: One system, three components, in order of need.
home.components_desc: SOURCE is a national research excellence management system owned by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, bringing the Ministry, universities and researchers into one ecosystem. It does not replace existing university systems; it works as a national integration layer where every service stems from a need the Ministry has defined.
home.comp1_desc: A unified national research database that gives the Ministry the full picture: researcher numbers, active fields, publication channels and the quality of research output in every field — with every figure traceable to its source.
home.comp2_desc: Universities manage research performance along two tracks: national accreditation under the National Centre for Quality Assurance, and international rankings (QS World, THE Arab, QS Arab) based on actual performance data.
home.comp2_item1: Research performance dashboards by university, college, department and researcher
home.comp2_item2: An institutional research profile with documented output records
home.comp2_item3: Improvement plans tied to ranking and accreditation indicators
home.comp2_item4: Tracking of projects, innovation and patents
home.comp3_desc: Value reaches the individual researcher across three stages — undergraduate, postgraduate, faculty — and three levels of enablement: capability through training, expertise through writing and review, and opportunity through networking and publication.
home.pillars_title: Four technical pillars beneath the three components
home.tile1_desc: Every research stage — submission, review, publication, archiving — in one connected system instead of paper and disconnected tools.
home.tile2_desc: Recommends, analyses, assesses readiness and matches journals — with a human always making the final call.
home.tile3_desc: Workflows move status between stages automatically, with alerts and tasks for the researcher and no manual follow-up.
home.tile4_desc: Production data hosted in-country, encryption, role-based access and full audit trails.
home.ai_title_pre: It detects patterns, explains them and proposes options —
home.ai_desc: Researcher recommendation, gap analysis, publication readiness, journal matching and institutional performance analysis — with human review of the highest-impact outputs and no unrestricted AI access to institutional databases.
home.layer1_desc: Records, projects, publication pipelines, dashboards and integrations
home.layer2_desc: Research assistants and analytical agents under clear governance
home.layer3_desc: Reviewers, methodologists, statisticians, editors, translators and publication advisors
home.journey_title: One research record, from Ministry intelligence to the researcher's profile — and back.
home.journey_desc: The same research record moves through every stage: each researcher's data feeds their university's indicators and the Ministry's dashboards, and the Ministry's priorities and funding flow back to guide the researcher — so dashboards, services and indicators are never treated as separate processes.
home.journey_step3: Aligning the idea with a priority
home.journey_loop: The Ministry is both the starting point and the feedback point: outputs return to the national database to measure impact, and priorities and funding are re-shaped from there.
home.services_desc: Every service is tied to the researcher's stage and to the research file itself — turning separate tasks into one measurable, trackable publication pipeline. It is always clear when a human expert delivers the service and when AI assists.
home.services_note: No AI result is presented as a final academic verdict, and SOURCE does not guarantee acceptance in any journal — that decision belongs to the journal and its editorial board.
home.ministry_title: The Ministry sees the national research picture — and acts on it.
home.ministry_desc: Not a reporting screen: a national research intelligence layer running on the data universities authorise for sharing, linked to state institutions' data, opportunities and partnerships — with clear governance and permissions.
home.ministry_q1_question: What is happening in scientific research nationally?
home.ministry_q2_question: What does the country need to research, and where are the gaps?
home.ministry_q3_question: Who should we collaborate with nationally, regionally and globally?
home.ministry_q4_question: Where is suitable funding, and for whom?
home.dash_alert1: Critical gap in a national priority
home.dash_source: Every figure traces back to its source: university, year, unit or official record.
home.cta_title: Start where you are: student, researcher, university or ministry.
home.cta_desc: One national platform, with tools and a path for every role.
